obligations.expected_behavior: Whole-plan terminal validation consumes explicit predecessors that are hash-bound and local to the current run.
forbidden_result: Validation proceeds using predecessors that are not explicit, hash-bound, or run-local.
obligations.observable_result: The terminal-validation input records show explicit hash-bound references to predecessors from the current run.
obligations.state_after: Validation has consumed only explicit hash-bound run-local predecessors.
obligations.state_before: Whole-plan terminal validation requires predecessor inputs but their binding and run locality are not yet established.
obligations.subject: Whole-plan terminal validation predecessor consumption

obligations.expected_behavior: Whole-plan terminal validation rejects history inference based on glob matching, modification times, or latest-success records.
forbidden_result: Validation selects history through glob inference.
Validation selects history through mtime inference.
Validation selects history through latest-success inference.
obligations.observable_result: A validation attempt relying on glob, mtime, or latest-success history is rejected.
obligations.state_after: Disallowed history-inference methods cannot determine terminal-validation inputs.
obligations.state_before: History could otherwise be inferred from glob, mtime, or latest-success records.
obligations.subject: Terminal-validation history selection
obligations.trigger: When terminal validation resolves historical predecessors or evidence

obligations.expected_behavior: Whole-plan terminal validation recomputes exact coverage for every active Acceptance.
forbidden_result: Validation relies on stale, partial, or inferred coverage for an active Acceptance.
Any active Acceptance is omitted from exact coverage recomputation.
obligations.observable_result: Each active Acceptance has a freshly recomputed exact coverage result in the terminal-validation output.
obligations.state_after: Exact coverage has been recomputed for all active Acceptances.
obligations.state_before: Active Acceptance coverage exists but has not yet been freshly and exactly recomputed for this validation.
obligations.subject: Active Acceptance coverage

obligations.expected_behavior: Terminal validation re-reads runtime evidence before publication.
forbidden_result: Publication uses runtime evidence read only before the current validation pass.
Publication proceeds without re-reading runtime evidence.
obligations.observable_result: The publication input contains a runtime-evidence read performed immediately in the current validation flow.
obligations.state_after: Publication is based on freshly re-read runtime evidence.
obligations.state_before: Runtime evidence may have been read earlier or may be stale at publication time.
obligations.subject: Runtime evidence freshness

obligations.expected_behavior: Terminal validation re-reads the current snapshot before publication.
forbidden_result: Publication uses an earlier snapshot without re-reading the current snapshot.
Publication proceeds without a current-snapshot read.
obligations.observable_result: The publication input contains a current-snapshot read performed in the current validation flow.
obligations.state_after: Publication is based on the current snapshot re-read during validation.
obligations.state_before: The snapshot available to validation may be outdated at publication time.
obligations.subject: Current snapshot freshness
